Dat COU  or directions No. e  and Registrar's  order with  Signatures  C482 No.1973 of 2023  Hon'ble Ashish Naithani, J.
Mr. Suresh Chandra Bhatt, learned counsel for the Applicant.
2.
Mr. Vijay Khanduri, learned Brief Holder for the State of Uttarakhand.
3. Ms. Amreen Bano, learned counsel holding brief of Mr. Apoorv Chauhan, learned counsel for the private Respondent.

4. The present application under Section 482 of CrPC filed on behalf of the Applicant challenging the entire proceedings of complaint case no.0131 of 2023, under Sections 376 of IPC, and under Section 5 (1)/6 of the POCSO Act.
5.

The matter is pending since 05.10.2023, and as per the order-sheet dated 16.10.2023, the coordinate Bench had made an observation that the charge-sheet is based on the statement of the victim recorded under Section 164 of CrPC
, however, the same has not been brought on record.

Further, it is noted that the learned counsel for the Applicant had prayed and was granted one week's time to bring on record 164 CrPC statement, but till today it is not on record, and on the last order-sheet passed by the coordinate Bench dated 24.06.2025, it is noted that "as a last chance,
learned counsel for the applicant seeks adjournment".
6. No objections have been filed on behalf of either of the Respondents may it be State or the private Respondent.
7.
Learned State Counsel, however, submits that there is a progress report though it is not part of the record.

8. By next date fixed, the statement of the victim under Sections 161 and 164 of the CrPC, positively be made part of the record and objections, if any, wished to be filed on behalf of the Respondent Nos.1 and 2, be done so.
In default, it will be taken as That no objection needs to be filed and the matter shall be decided accordingly.

1 9.
Further learned counsel for the Applicant claims that in the present matter, the victim was major and the incident at the time of being reported was said to be five years back.

10. Learned counsel for the Applicant, if wishes, to take such a ground in support of the Applicant may file the age verification report in form of the certificate or in any other manner prescribed by the law by the next date fixed.
11. Learned State Counsel is directed to submit a progress report as what is the state of affairs before the learned Trial Court.

12. List this matter on 29.10.2025.
(Ashish Naithani, J.) 07.10.2025 Nitesh/
